name: Brad W. Crihfield
office: Bellflower Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Brad Crihfield is the Vice President of the Bellflower Unified School District Board for Trustee Area 5. He has served on the board since 2022. He is also a City Safety Commissioner for Lakewood and a board member for California Advancing Pathways for Students. His campaign says he helped form a safety committee and add armed perimeter security and vape detection systems at high schools. He reports helping hire the district’s first public information officer and stream board meetings with Spanish translation. In 2024, as board president, he announced the board's decision to part ways with the superintendent to ensure stability.
